fuel_consumption.source_quote: Fuel consumption not stated in item7a for FY ended March 31, 2006. Zero cost collar covers ~16% of Q1 FY2007 fuel (quarter ending June 30, 2006).

instrument_type_details.notes: Zero cost collar agreement entered November 28, 2005 on Gulf Coast Jet A fuel: cap $1.83/gal, floor $1.6925/gal. Covers approximately 16% of fuel requirements for Q ending June 30, 2006 (Q1 FY2007). Net fair value = $976,000 (asset) at March 31, 2006. Derivative gains for FY2006 = $3,175,000. Note: Frontier Airlines Holdings, Inc. (CIK 1351548) is the parent company that also filed a 10-K for FY ended March 31, 2006 with identical fuel hedging disclosures.
